location: MIPI CSI-2, DSI, HDMI & USB Differential Pairs, F.Cu @(21.5, 25.0)mm
finding: HighSpeed_100R (100 Ohm MIPI/HDMI) and HighSpeed_90R (90 Ohm USB) netclasses were unassigned in .kicad_pro, and MIPI/HDMI pairs on F.Cu were routed at 0.150mm Default width instead of 0.127mm (100 Ohm).
evidence: CM5-AI-Cam-CopperPilot.kicad_pro netclass_patterns=[], README.md conflated 90R/100R, F.Cu segments at 0.150mm
rule: Raspberry Pi CM5 Datasheet, MIPI D-PHY / HDMI 1.4b (100R diff) & USB 2.0 (90R diff), JLCPCB JLC06161H-7628
root_cause: Netclass patterns were cleared in .kicad_pro and MIPI/HDMI traces left at Default 0.150mm width while USB traces were 0.180mm.
proposed_fix: Assign HighSpeed_100R (0.127mm/0.150mm, 100.1 Ohm) to MIPI/HDMI and HighSpeed_90R (0.180mm/0.150mm, 89.6 Ohm) to USB in .kicad_pro, update MIPI/HDMI traces to 0.127mm, and enforce widths in .kicad_dru.
fix_risk: None; narrowing 0.150mm traces to 0.127mm strictly increases copper clearance while hitting 100.1 Ohm.
verification_method: kicad-cli pcb drc passes with HighSpeed_100R_Impedance_Width and HighSpeed_90R_Impedance_Width rules; pytest passes.

finding: C20 on 24 MHz camera MCLK was 0.1uF (72.3 kHz low-pass cutoff attenuating MCLK) instead of 10pF (C32949, fc=723 MHz); critical LCSC mismatches on R20 (C25916 6.49k -> 1.07V buck output), U3 (C7434207 3.3V LDO on 1.2V core), U1 (invalid C114059), U5 (C2837379 LED), HDMI1 (C2013978 oscillator), L1-L3 (C49073870 3.2x2.5mm choke), C21 (C1547 12pF), and DNP R31-R33 in BOM/CPL.
evidence: Circuit & LCSC catalog audit: C20=0.1uF shorts 24MHz MCLK; R20=C25916 sets VOUT=1.07V; U3=C7434207 outputs 3.3V on 1.2V rail
rule: Sony IMX219 MCLK spec, MPS MP1658 & Richtek RT9013/RT9193 datasheets, JLCPCB PCBA BOM verification
root_cause: C20 was harmonized to 0.1uF instead of 10pF; incorrect supplier LCSC codes entered in schematic/BOM; pos export omitted --exclude-dnp.
proposed_fix: Restore C20 to 10pF (C32949), update LCSC codes (R20->C25803, U3->C47773, U1->C15075, U5->C2960187, HDMI1->C424662, L1-L3->C110443, C21->C1534), standardize C3/C10/C14 to 0.1uF, and exclude DNP R31-R33.
fix_risk: None; restores 24MHz camera MCLK, 3.305V buck regulation, 1.2V camera core safety, and Wi-Fi/BT operation.
verification_method: ERC 0 errors, DRC --schematic-parity 0 issues, pytest test_critical_bom_lcsc_and_dnp_exclusion passes.
